What is Dhani win?

Dhani win is a mobile-first entertainment app with a shelf of short, easy mini games. Every game runs on play coins — a score you earn by showing up and playing well, not something you buy. There is no wallet in the app, no payment screen, and nothing to cash out. It exists for one reason: five spare minutes should be fun.

1

Quick sessions

Most games finish in under a minute, so you can play one round in a queue and pick up your streak later.

2

Free coins, always

You start with 5,000 play coins and your balance refills every day. No purchases exist anywhere in the app.

3

Play with friends

Share your invite code, add friends, and see who holds the longest streak on the weekly board.

4

Light and fast

A lightweight experience designed to run smoothly on older Android and iOS phones — or play straight in your browser.

How coins work

Coins are your score. They keep track of how you're doing and unlock cosmetic badges — nothing more.

  • 5,000 coins the moment you register
  • A free refill every morning
  • Login-streak rewards that grow over seven days
  • No way to buy, sell or transfer them for money

Invite your friends

Share your invite code and you both receive a coin bundle. There are no commissions and no earnings involved.

  • Copy your code from the Friends tab
  • Send it to a friend on any app
  • They enter it while registering
  • 2,000 bonus coins for each of you

Play in a healthy way

Nothing here costs money, but your time still matters. A few habits we build into the app:

  • A gentle reminder after 45 minutes of play
  • Coins treated as a score, never as savings
  • Age confirmation at signup — 18 and over
